participation.note: Share of observed blocks where an INBOUND peer (one that dialled us) was among the announcers, and among the earliest announcers. `inbound` is NOT the same as non-listening: a listening node can dial us too, so this is an UPPER bound on private participation, not a public/private split. It measures RELAY participation, not production — blocks are produced by miners/pools, never by 'a public or private node'. First-party and one-vantage only.
